item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-10-20
item.description: GB/Z 185—2026, the seven-part national standardisation guidance document series on agent interconnection published by SAMR on 2026-06-26, arrived with a reference implementation (AIP) and a community — and an inspection of that community on AtomGit and its operating zone aip.openatom.tech on 2026-10-20 shows 0 pull requests, 0 forks, 44 stars and 12.25K downloads across its repositories, with 11 of 12 organisation repositories archived (latest archival 2026-06-22). Read against the CESI/Mulan open-source standards sub-forum held in Beijing on 2026-10-13 — where Mulan's new incubated Xingzhu project (ZTE-led, targeting Clink GPU-interconnect protocol landing) was launched and where the SJ/T 12304-2026 L1-L5 / O1-O4 LLM openness grading framework was presented as an assessment tool — the two events describe the same institutional move: the standard is the specification, the code is a conformance fixture, and the community is a distribution channel.
